journeys.failure: product gap (graph-originated controlled write): the published graph executes successfully but cannot itself invoke a connector. The graph executor's node dispatch table has no connector node (internal/presetexec/graphrun.go) and the agent tool call is always capability_kind="tool" (internal/presetexec/agent.go), resolved by the tool branch that ignores tool_versions.connector_versions (internal/capabilities/service.go); the F04B approval node explicitly never authorizes a later external write (internal/presetexec/approval.go). So the same Run's manifest carries the approved write policy, yet the graph emits zero connector operations and the endpoint sees zero writes. J6 closes the AC2 authorization/exactly-once chain through the documented worker capability seam; 'the published task itself triggers the write' needs the product change described in reports/f12/T101-journeys.md §5.
